blocks.text: Catalytic converter ceramic ya metal ka ek monolith (ek hi thos tukra) hai jis ki structure (banawat) shahad ke chhatte (honeycomb) jaisi hai (Figure 12.6). Is ke andar ke channels par alumina ki teh (layer) hoti hai taa ke surface area zyada ho. Is alumina par mehngi noble metals, jaise Pt (platinum), Pd (palladium) aur Rh (rhodium), phaila di jati hain.

Yeh metals teen redox reactions ko tez (catalyse) karti hain jo exhaust ki harmful (nuqsan dene wali) gases ko hata deti hain. Three-way converter harmful CO, NO aur hydrocarbons ko CO₂, N₂ aur pani mein badal deta hai. Yeh qeemti metals dobara istemal (recycle) bhi ho sakti hain.

blocks.alt: Catalytic converter ka cut-away (andar se kata hua) view: left side nikalne wala pipe, beech mein chaura metal body jis mein shahad ke chhatte (honeycomb) jaise do monolith blocks hain, aur right side andar aane wala pipe. Mote peele teer dikhate hain ke HC, CO, NOx neeche right se andar aati hain, chhatte se guzarti hain aur oopar left se H2O, CO2, N2 ban kar nikalti hain. Ek line (lakeer) block ke andar ishara karti hai: 'washcoat with catalyst inside the monolith channel'.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.6: Three-way catalytic converter (kitab ki Figure 12.6 jaisa original diagram).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chhatte jaise channels ki deewaron par alumina ki teh (washcoat) hai jis par Pt, Pd aur Rh lage hain. Gases jab in channels se guzarti hain to teen kaam hote hain: NO ka N₂ mein reduction, aur CO aur hydrocarbons ka CO2 aur pani mein oxidation. Isi liye ise 'three-way' kehte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne yahan aur ethene wali equation mein catalyst 'Pt/Rd' likha hai. 'Rd' kisi element ka symbol nahi; sahi rhodium (Rh) hai, yani Pt/Rh.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Reduction mein NO apni oxygen kho kar N₂ ban jati hai, aur CO woh oxygen le kar CO₂ ban jati hai. Oxidation mein CO aur hydrocarbon (yahan ethene, C₂H₄) oxygen le kar CO₂ aur pani bante hain. Catalyst khud kharch nahi hota; woh sirf reactions ko tez karta hai.

items: Honeycomb monolith, alumina ki teh, us par Pt, Pd, Rh.
